name: Silo
summary: The Silo packs hay into hay wads. The developer explains that needles can stay inside those wads, so follow the output toward a scanner before selling.

data.operation: Inspect the Silo’s stored hay and needle messages, then watch its output belt. A needle still listed inside is not the same as a needle already scanned.
data.community: A player suggests adding enough loose hay to complete another output load when a needle is waiting. This is a community suggestion, with no confirmed universal batch size or guaranteed fix.
data.check: Avoid dismantling a Silo to recover a needle: a player reported a destruction warning. Keep your save and inspect feed, output and scanning first.

sources.label: Developer reply and player reports · September 13, 2026
